APPROVE
The extracted helpers keep the original check order and logic (the short-circuited `||` still tests the section before the indent and `- ` check, and `entry` is definitely assigned after the `continue`), and moving the indent check, the two branch bodies and the join loop out leaves the method well under 15. I couldn't open the file here, so the build is judged from the diff alone, assuming `direct`, `resolved` and `lockPath` match the helper parameter types and the join code uses no other locals.
